arxiv-1406-7140.title: Conservation and losses of avian non-coding RNA loci
arxiv-1406-7140.creator: Paul P. Gardner 1 , 2, Mario Fasold 5,6, Sarah W. Burge 3, Maria Ninova 4, Jana Hertel 5, Stephanie Kehr 5, Tammy E. Steeves 1, Sam Griffiths-Jones 4 and Peter F. Stadler 5
arxiv-1406-7140.description: Abstract Here we present the results of a large-scale bioinformatic annotation of non-coding RNA loci in 48 avian genomes. Our approach uses probabilistic models of hand-curated families from the Rfam database to infer conserved RNA families within each avian genome. We supplement these annotations with predictions from the tRNA annotation tool, tRNAscan-SE and microRNAs from miRBase.

arxiv-2001-06299.title: Thermodynamics in f ⁡ ( R , ℒ ) f(R,\mathcal{L}) theories: Apparent horizon in the FLRW spacetime
arxiv-2001-06299.creator: Prabir Rudra
arxiv-2001-06299.description: Abstract In this paper we study the recently proposed f ⁡ ( R , ℒ ) f(R,\mathcal{L}) theories from a thermodynamic point of view. The uniqueness of these theories lies in the fact that the space-time curvature is coupled to the baryonic matter instead of exotic matter (in the form of scalar field).

arxiv-2208-09428.title: Quantifying Resolutions for DNS and LES for Lax-Wendroff Method: Application to Uniform/Non-Uniform Compact Schemes
arxiv-2208-09428.creator: V. K. Suman, P. Sundaram, Soumyo Sengupta, Aditi Sengupta, Tapan K. Sengupta
arxiv-2208-09428.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by V. K. Suman, P. Sundaram, Soumyo Sengupta, Aditi Sengupta, Tapan K. Sengupta. The global spectral analysis (GSA) of numerical methods ensures that the dispersion relation preserving (DRP) property is calibrated in addition to ensuring numerical stability, as advocated in the von Neumann analysis. The DRP nature plays a major role where spatio-temporal dependence in the governing equation and boundary conditions has to be retained, such as in direct numerical simulations (DNS) and large eddy simulations (LES) of fluid flow transition.

arxiv-2211-16273.title: Persistent homology as a probe for center vortices and deconfinement in SU(2) lattice gauge theory
arxiv-2211-16273.creator: Jeffrey Giansiracusa
arxiv-2211-16273.description: Abstract Topological Data Analysis (TDA) is a field that leverages tools and ideas from algebraic topology to provide robust methods for analysing geometric and topological aspects of data. One of the principal tools of TDA, persistent homology, produces a quantitative description of how the connectivity and structure of data changes when viewed over a sequence of scales.

arxiv-2212-09627.title: Hamiltonian limit of lattice QED in 2+1 dimensions
arxiv-2212-09627.creator: C. Urbach
arxiv-2212-09627.description: Abstract The Hamiltonian limit of lattice gauge theories can be found by extrapolating the results of anisotropic lattice computations, i.e., computations using lattice actions with different temporal and spatial lattice spacings ( a t ≠ a s a_{t}\neq a_{s} ), to the limit of a t → 0 a_{t}\to 0 .

arxiv-2301-07350.title: Variation of small scale magnetic fields over a century using Ca-K images as proxy
arxiv-2301-07350.creator: Jagdev Singh, Muthu Priyal, B. Ravindra, Luca Bertello, Alexei Pevtsov
arxiv-2301-07350.description: Abstract A combined uniform and long-time series of Ca-K images from the Kodaikanal Observatory (KO), Mount Wilson Observatory (MWO), and Mauna Loa Solar Observatory (MLSO) were used to identify and study the Ca-K small-scale features and their solar cycle variations over a century.

arxiv-2306-16856.title: LIME - a gas TPC prototype for directional Dark Matter search for the CYGNO experiment
arxiv-2306-16856.creator: Fernando Domingues Amaro, Elisabetta Baracchini, Luigi Benussi, Stefano Bianco, Cesidio Capoccia, Michele Caponero, Danilo Santos Cardoso, Gianluca Cavoto, André Cortez, Igor Abritta Costa, Emiliano Dané, Giorgio Dho, Flaminia Di Giambattista, Emanuele Di Marco, Giulia D’Imperio, Francesco Iacoangel
arxiv-2306-16856.description: Abstract The CYGNO experiment aims at the development of a large gaseous TPC with GEM-based amplification and an optical readout by means of PMTs and scientific CMOS cameras for 3D tracking down to O(keV) energies, for the directional detection of rare events such as low mass Dark Matter and solar neutrino interactions.

arxiv-2307-15207.title: Spin Coupling Effect on Geometry-Dependent X-ray Absorption of Diradicals
arxiv-2307-15207.creator: Scott M. Garner, Eric A. Haugen, Stephen R. Leone, Eric Neuscamman
arxiv-2307-15207.description: Abstract We theoretically investigate the influence of diradical electron spin coupling on the time-resolved X-ray absorption spectra of the photochemical ring opening of furanone. We predict geometry dependent carbon K-edge signals involving transitions from core orbitals to both singly and unoccupied molecular orbitals.

arxiv-2308-08479.title: DeDoDe: Detect, Don’t Describe — Describe, Don’t Detect for Local Feature Matching
arxiv-2308-08479.creator: Johan Edstedt, Georg Bökman, Mårten Wadenbäck, Michael Felsberg
arxiv-2308-08479.description: Abstract Keypoint detection is a pivotal step in 3D reconstruction, whereby sets of (up to) K points are detected in each view of a scene. Crucially, the detected points need to be consistent between views, i.e., correspond to the same 3D point in the scene. One of the main challenges with keypoint detection is the formulation of the learning objective.

arxiv-2505-06009.title: A Study of the Spectral Properties of Gamma-Ray Bursts with the Main and Second Bursts
arxiv-2505-06009.creator: Ze-Lian Du, Zhao-Yang Peng, Jia-Ming Chen, Yue Yin, Ting Li
arxiv-2505-06009.description: Abstract The origins of the main burst and second burst of gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) and the composition of their jets remain uncertain. To explore this complex subject more thoroughly, we conduct a spectral analysis on 18 GRBs with a main and a second burst observed by Fermi/GBM.

arxiv-2510-00553.title: On Predictability of Reinforcement Learning Dynamics for Large Language Models
arxiv-2510-00553.creator: Yuchen Cai, Ding Cao, Xin Xu, Zijun Yao, Yuqing Huang, Zhenyu Tan, Benyi Zhang, Guiquan Liu, Junfeng Fang
arxiv-2510-00553.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuchen Cai, Ding Cao, Xin Xu, Zijun Yao, Yuqing Huang, Zhenyu Tan, Benyi Zhang, Guiquan Liu, Junfeng Fang. Recent advances in reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) are largely driven by reinforcement learning (RL), yet the underlying parameter dynamics during RL training remain poorly understood.

arxiv-2510-01521.title: Carbon X : An Open-Source Tool for Computational Decarbonization Using Time Series Foundation Models
arxiv-2510-01521.creator: Diptyaroop Maji 1 † , Kang Yang 2 † , Prashant Shenoy 1 , Ramesh K. Sitaraman 1 , Mani Srivastava 2
arxiv-2510-01521.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Diptyaroop Maji 1 † , Kang Yang 2 † , Prashant Shenoy 1 , Ramesh K. Sitaraman 1 , Mani Srivastava 2. Computational decarbonization aims to reduce carbon emissions in computing and societal systems such as data centers, transportation, and built environments.

Objective Our aim in this study was to identify management options for reducing the spread of antibiotics and antib

pmc-11297646.title: Knock down of transforming growth factor beta improves expressions of co-stimulatory molecules, type I interferon-regulated genes, and pro-inflammatory cytokine in PRRSV-inoculated monocyte-derived macrophages
pmc-11297646.creator: Dante Fabros, Wasin Charerntantanakul
pmc-11297646.description: Porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus (PRRSV) induces a poor innate immune response following infection. This study evaluates the effects of transforming growth factor beta 1 (TGFβ1) up-regulated by PRRSV on gene expressions of co-stimulatory molecules, type I interferon (IFN), type I IFN-regulated genes (IRGs), pattern recognition receptors, and pro-inflammatory cytokines in PRRSV-inoculated monocyte-derived macrophages (MDMs).

pmc-11470654.title: Baseline level of interleukin-6 is associated with the risk of acute coronary syndrome development in SARS-CoV‐2 infection
pmc-11470654.creator: Mohsen Sedighi, Mohammad Hasan Shahabi, Maryam Akbarpour, Alireza Amanollahi, Nader Tavakoli, Aydin Mohammad Valipour, Hamed Basir Ghafouri
pmc-11470654.description: BackgroundAcute coronary syndrome (ACS) is frequently reported in patients with coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). Cytokine storm induced by interleukin-6 (IL-6) has been suggested to potentially cause myocardial injury in COVID-19. We investigated the association between baseline level of IL-6 and development of ACS in COVID-19 patients.MethodsDemographic and clinical data of hospitalized COVID-19 patients from 2020 to 2022 were reviewed.

pmc-11480327.title: Association between uric acid and the risk of depressive symptoms in US adults: results from NHANES 2005–2018
pmc-11480327.creator: Jinhua Wang, Ming Yang, Haiyan Lin, Jiao Wang
pmc-11480327.description: BackgroundThis study explores the relationship between serum uric acid(UA) levels and depression. UA is the final product of purine metabolism in the human body, possessing certain physiological functions such as blood pressure regulation, antioxidation, DNA protection, and anti-aging, thereby drawing attention for its potential role in preventing and treating depression.

pmc-12935532.title: Global patterns of commodity-driven deforestation and associated carbon emissions
pmc-12935532.creator: Chandrakant Singh, U. Martin Persson
pmc-12935532.description: Rapid agriculture-driven deforestation poses considerable challenges to achieving climate and biodiversity targets. However, the limited scope and comprehensiveness of the datasets available for linking deforestation to food production restrict their effectiveness in supporting forest conservation and climate change mitigation efforts.

pmc-13295057.title: SERS Activity in Gold Particles Obtained via a Modified Seeded-Growth Method
pmc-13295057.creator: Jathziri Avalos-Grajales, Mario Alejandro Millán-Franco, Lucia Ortega-Cabello, Edgar Eduardo Mosquera-Vargas, José Reyes-Gasga
pmc-13295057.description: Precise control over nanoparticle morphology and spatial arrangement is fundamental for optimizing plasmonic performance. This study investigates the role of the HAuCl4/NaBH4 molar ratio in governing the formation kinetics, structure and Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering (SERS) response of gold nanoparticles (AuNPs) synthesized via seed-mediated approach in which triangular gold nanoparticles (T-AuNPs) account for an increased fraction.

pmc-13476629.title: Cerebral Palsy and Postoperative Outcomes After Distal Radius Fracture Repair: A Retrospective Analysis
pmc-13476629.creator: David B Frumberg, Julian Smith-Voudouris, Alexander J Kammien, Michael J Gouzoulis, Ally Ae Lim Yang, David L Colen, Jonathan N Grauer
pmc-13476629.description: PurposeTo identify if patients with cerebral palsy (CP) are at increased risk of postoperative complications and repeat surgery following open reduction and internal fixation (ORIF) for distal radius fractures both acutely and in the long-term following their surgery.MethodsUsing the Mariner 161 PearlDiver dataset, adult patients undergoing ORIF following a DRF were identified.

pmc-13595993.title: Meta-analysis and acupoint selection patterns of acupuncture for post-stroke foot drop
pmc-13595993.creator: Yuxin Huang, Yueqi Lin, Bohui Zheng, Xinyi Zhao, Qi Su, Yina Wang, Jiaqi Ai, Wenbin Fu, Chuhua Lin
pmc-13595993.description: BackgroundFoot drop is a common complication of stroke, often causing difficulties in walking, restricted mobility, and reduced independence and quality of life. Timely systematic treatment for patients with foot drop after stroke is essential to restore foot function and improve quality of life.
